newsitem.title: SPAIN: Endesa - ATT may enter telecom consortium via Stet.
newsitem.headline: Endesa - ATT may enter telecom consortium via Stet.

text.p: The possibility of AT&T Corp or Unisource participating in Endesa's consortium with Italy's Stet to buy Retevision depends on negotiations between AT&T and Stet, Endesa Chief Executive Rafael Miranda said on Tuesday.
"Stet is completing negotiations, a global alliance with AT&T and Unisource...and if they reach an agreement, it should be reflected in the Retevision consortium" he told reporters.
Retevision is to become Spain's second basic telephone operator.
Endesa's chairman, Rodolfo Martin Villa, said he expected a decision soon on who wins the auction of Retevision.
If the electricity firm's group wins the auction, mobile phone operator Airtel could tie in nicely.
"Airtel could be an important element for the second operator...(Endesa would have to) find a formula for it to be integrated," Miranda said.
